9e11c470.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

d5de3eab.text: it’s just a piece of the line,

f0fde20f.text: one of the cables that makes it work.

b260c7c3.text: So if I hear the hum, that means you’re on,

523ef024.text: that means your line is busy,

65e86c4b.text: you are busy with the cable,

5db89af5.text: that is the way the switch works,

6a338c5a.text: the line is humming and I don’t know why

01f6c785.text: and you know I know that that is why,

46463260.text: you can hear it in my voice,

03ecde7f.text: but you won’t let me talk to you

4af257d1.text: until it stops. And so the hum is going.

0d1bb62c.text: What is this? I don’t get it.

27181555.text: Is that a phone or an electrical line?

2303d50c.text: The switch says: what is this?

ae28fe0c.text: I hear that sound on your line but it doesn’t mean anything to me.

b4174e14.text: But I know it's you and I am humming for you.

7c87fcd7.text: The humming is gone. The line has stopped.

929db296.text: We're back now. The switch is done.

70cb8a13.text: I am trying to dial. It’s me.

ff6ea5a5.text: I try to dial myself, but the dial is gone.

14d2cb83.text: I am humming but no one answers.

c6f31796.text: I try the phone. No answer.
